nodes.name: MySQL (Update cold_reach_leads - Instantly Add Lead Fail)1

parameters.query:
select 
      lc.main_category,
	 lc.category,
	 lc.category_group,
	 lc.category_tr,
	 lc.category_group_tr,
     bl.*
from business_leads bl join lead_category lc  on bl.category =lc.category
  
where (bl.email IS NOT NULL 
or bl.email1 IS NOT NULL)
AND  bl.email1 !='[email if found]'
  AND (
 lc.main_category = 'Doktor'  or
  lc.main_category = 'İmmo'
  or lc.main_category = 'Avukat'
  )
  and 
( -- bl.pipelined = 1 OR
  bl.pipelined IS NULL OR bl.pipelined = 0) 
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
 limit 200

SELECT 
    cn.*, 
    bl.*, 
    lc.main_category
FROM 
    companies_new cn
JOIN 
    business_leads bl ON cn.cid = bl.cid
JOIN 
    lead_category lc ON bl.category = lc.category
WHERE 
    lc.main_category = 'Doktor'  or
  lc.main_category = 'İmmo' or
  lc.main_category = 'Avukat'
